newsitem.title: USA: Putnam closes New Opportunities to most new money.
newsitem.headline: Putnam closes New Opportunities to most new money.

text.p: Putnam Investments said on Friday that it will close the $13.5 billion Putnam New Opportunities Fund to most forms of new investments so its managers could control growth of the fund's assets.

The aggressive growth fund will remain open only to those retail shareholders who make systematic investments and to institutional shareholders, including those enrolled in 401(k) plans, the company said.
The Putnam Capital Manager VT New Opportunities account, a variable life and annuity product, remains open to investors, the company said.
The Putnam New Opportunities Fund is managed by Daniel Miller and Carol McMullen.
"Our decision is based on the continuing high level of cash flows into the fund," Tim Ferguson, Putnam's chief of equity investments, said in a statement.
The fund will be closed to most new investments on June 24, Putnam said.
Investors may find alternatives to the fund in Putnam International New Opportunities Fund, Putnam New Value Fund, Putnam Vista Fund and Putnam Voyager Fund, Putnam said.
